/* ===== FEEL THE VIBES — video slideshow =====
   One video at a time, smooth snap, no control row — a single subtle
   animated swipe-right hint sits below the track instead. PER-VIDEO
   FRAMES: there is no single fixed frame. Each slide's frame carries
   that video's own natural aspect ratio — the eleven portrait reels
   (640×1138, slides 1/2/3/5/6/7/8/9/10/11/12) get a tall 320/569 frame
   via .vid-frame.tall, and the three wide videos (640×360, slides
   4/13/14 — the DMT one among them) keep the wide 16/9 frame. Because
   each frame's shape IS its video's shape, object-fit:contain is an
   exact edge-to-edge fill: no side bars, no letterbox, no pillarbox,
   no crop, no stretch, no zoom — every video shown whole, exactly as
   shot. On phone widths a tall frame spans the slide's full width; on
   wide screens its width is capped and centred so a portrait reel
   never becomes a two-metre column. The track's height follows the
   CURRENT slide's frame (see fit() in the slideshow script), so a
   wide video never sits in a tall slide's empty space and a tall
   reel is never clipped by a wide slide's height. The edge-fade
   overlay is OFF for these frames: with the video filling the frame
   exactly, a fade would only wash the picture's own edges.
   Each frame carries the blue neon glow border. Tap a video to play
   it with sound, tap again to pause; the small centre pill is
   pointer-events:none (never a big overlay), and each slide's
   speaker button stays visible as its only mute control. */

   grid, and a grid item with auto side margins shrink-wraps to its content
   width — and every child of the stage is absolutely positioned, so its
   content width is 0 and the whole ring crushes to a centre line. A
   definite width (capped by .svcweb's max-width:520px) keeps the ring
   full-size and centred at any viewport. */

   ring can never collapse, pile up or detach from the centre hub at any
   width or timing. Nodes centre on their slot via this transform. */

<!-- INTRO — Taylor's own intro video, the one he attached: the water-effect orb
     swirling, the PV monogram resolving in its purple disc with the PREMIERE VIBES
     wordmark, then the zoom into the logo. His file was a phone screen recording
     (HEVC), so the upgrade is delivery-only. The recording's own video picture was
     lifted out untouched (phone status bar, player controls and black bars removed —
     nothing of the video itself re-timed, re-animated or redesigned) and reframed
     for a phone screen: the picture is enlarged 1.5x and centered on a portrait
     720x1566 canvas whose background is the video's own glow, blurred and carried
     to every edge — so on a phone the intro is full-screen and full-bleed, the orb
     large and dominant, exactly the video's own colors with no overlay or dimming.
     Re-encoded iPhone-safe (H.264 High@L4.0, 30fps, limited-range yuv420p,
     fast-start, ~2MB). If the video still cannot play on a device, the fallback
     shows the video's OWN frames (water-orb frame, then the PV logo frame) so the
     logo ALWAYS appears in the video's real look — and if the video starts moving
     after all, it takes back over from the frames. Muted autoplay, Skip always
     available, sound on request while the video path is live. -->
<div id="intro" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Premiere Vibes intro animation">
  <video id="introVid" src="data:application/octet-stream;base64," poster="data:image/webp;base64," autoplay muted playsinline webkit-playsinline preload="auto" aria-label="Premiere Vibes logo reveal animation"></video>

  </button>
  <button class="intro-skip" id="introSkip" type="button" data-i="introSkip">Skip →</button>

<script>
/* ================= INTRO — starts immediately, logo ALWAYS appears, never hangs ====
   Runs the moment the intro markup is parsed, before the rest of the page's scripts.
   Two routes to the same water-orb -> PV logo reveal from Taylor's attached video:
   1) VIDEO route — his video, delivery-upgraded only (H.264 L4.0 / 30fps / limited
      range / fast-start, reframed full-screen portrait from his own picture),
      plays muted right away; Skip + sound toggle wired at once.
   2) FRAMES route — only if the video hard-errors, play() stays rejected, no frame
      advances within 3.5s, or playback stalls ~3s before the reveal: the video's
      OWN frames take over (water-orb frame crossfading to the PV logo frame,
      gentle zoom, ~5.9s) — and hand control BACK to the video the moment it
      starts advancing, so the moving water is what plays whenever the device
      can play it. The visitor always sees the real logo — never a spinner, a
      substitute animation, or a bare failsafe jump. Reduced-motion visitors
      skip straight to the homepage. */
(function(){
  var intro=document.getElementById('intro'),vid=document.getElementById('introVid');
  if(!intro)return;
  var finished=false,healthy=false,fbStarted=false,fbTimer=null;
  function finish(){
    if(finished)return;finished=true;
    try{if(vid)vid.pause();}catch(e){}
    intro.classList.add('done');
    document.documentElement.classList.remove('intro-lock');
    setTimeout(function(){if(intro.parentNode)intro.parentNode.removeChild(intro);},720);
  }
  /* FRAMES route: crossfade the video's own frames over ~5.9s, then fade out.
     Only a hard media error pauses the video — a merely slow start keeps
     buffering behind the frames, and if it starts advancing the video route
     takes back over (see markHealthy), so the moving water wins whenever the
     device can play it at all. */
  function startFallback(){
    if(finished||fbStarted||healthy)return;
    fbStarted=true;
    if(vid&&vid.error){try{vid.pause();}catch(e){}}
    intro.classList.add('fb-on');
    fbTimer=setTimeout(finish,5900);
  }
  function cancelFallback(){
    if(!fbStarted)return;
    fbStarted=false;
    if(fbTimer){clearTimeout(fbTimer);fbTimer=null;}
    intro.classList.remove('fb-on');
  }
  var reduce=false;
  try{reduce=window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;}catch(e){}
  if(reduce){if(intro.parentNode)intro.parentNode.removeChild(intro);return;}
  document.documentElement.classList.add('intro-lock');
  var skip=document.getElementById('introSkip');
  if(skip)skip.addEventListener('click',function(e){e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();finish();});
  var snd=document.getElementById('introSnd');
  if(snd&&vid)snd.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();
    if(fbStarted)return;
    vid.muted=!vid.muted;
    snd.classList.toggle('on',!vid.muted);
    snd.setAttribute('aria-label',vid.muted?'Turn intro sound on':'Turn intro sound off');
    if(!vid.muted&&vid.paused){var p=vid.play();if(p&&p.catch)p.catch(function(){});}
  });
  if(!vid){startFallback();setTimeout(finish,6300);return;}
  /* muted + inline set in code as well as markup: iOS only allows the autoplay
     when both are true at the moment play() is called */
  try{vid.muted=true;vid.defaultMuted=true;vid.playsInline=true;}catch(e){}
  /* healthy = the picture is actually advancing, not just a 'playing' event.
     The moment it advances, the real (moving) video takes over — even if the
     frames route had already stepped in during a slow start. */
  function markHealthy(){
    if(vid.currentTime>0.12){
      healthy=true;
      if(fbStarted&&!finished){cancelFallback();var p=vid.play();if(p&&p.catch)p.catch(function(){});}
    }
  }
  vid.addEventListener('playing',markHealthy);
  vid.addEventListener('timeupdate',markHealthy);
  vid.addEventListener('ended',function(){if(!fbStarted)finish();});
  vid.addEventListener('error',function(){if(!healthy)startFallback();});
  var srcEl=vid.querySelector('source');
  if(srcEl)srcEl.addEventListener('error',function(){if(!healthy)startFallback();});
  try{
    var pr=vid.play();
    if(pr&&pr.catch)pr.catch(function(){setTimeout(function(){if(!healthy)startFallback();},1500);});
  }catch(e){startFallback();}
  /* never-start: no advancing frame within 3.5s -> frames route steps in (and
     steps back out again if the video starts moving after all) */
  setTimeout(function(){if(!healthy)startFallback();},3500);
  /* stall watchdog: frozen ~3s before the reveal point -> frames route; frozen
     after it (logo already seen) -> fade out. Media error -> frames route. */
  var lastT=-1,stalls=0;
  var wd=setInterval(function(){
    if(finished){clearInterval(wd);return;}
    if(fbStarted)return;
    if(vid.error){startFallback();return;}
    if(healthy&&!vid.paused&&!vid.ended){
      if(lastT>=0&&vid.currentTime<=lastT+0.01){
        stalls++;
        if(stalls>=6){if(vid.currentTime<5.0)startFallback();else finish();}
      }else stalls=0;
      lastT=vid.currentTime;
    }
  },500);
  /* absolute cap: video route ends ~7s; frames route ends ~5.9s; nothing lives past 10s */
  setTimeout(finish,10000);
})();
</script>

    <section class="reel" aria-label="Premiere Vibes showreel">

        <video id="pvReel" src="data:application/octet-stream;base64,
